title: Faster keyboard navigation and clearer loot forms
summary: Keyboard users can skip straight to each screen's content, and the Add loot and shop edit forms label every field.
items: The first Tab on any app screen shows "Skip to content", which jumps past the navigation.
The desktop navigation has one Settings & Management stop instead of two; the gear in the header opens it.
Add loot now labels Name, Value, Quantity, Owner and Category above each field, and its button reads "Add loot".
Shop edit labels the shop name, shopkeeper, location, prices and quantities above each field.
